fields.label: rationale
fields.value: The instrument works and the customer intends to pay; the money isn't there today. The most recoverable failure in the taxonomy, and timing does the work rather than persistence — retry on payday, not on backoff. One soft nudge, because the customer can act. Then a link: three failures spanning two paydays means the timing hypothesis has been tested and lost. Nudge plus link is two contacts, which is exactly §7's per-episode cap.
